chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Fletcher Henderson's band: college one-nighters and sidemen
summary: Mosley is the only trombone in Henderson's band, playing colleges, and Driggs checks names against his memory.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Cornell?
I don't know--I don't remember playing Cornell with Fletcher. We played Dartmouth up in New Hampshire; all over New England.
One nighters?
Yes, one nighters at the colleges.
Now, I got George Thigpen in that band; do you remember him? Herman Autrey?
Which band?
Fletcher's band.
Yeah, yeah.
That's why I remember those name so well.
Otis Johnson?
Those are the guys that were in the band.
Frank Galbraith wasn't in the band?
I don't remember.
Bob Shoffner?
I don't remember Bob Shoffner. Maybe he was.
You were the only trombone player?
The only trombone player.
That's unusual, because they usually have two.
Cecil Scott--
Cecil Scott, that's where I met him; that's where I met Cecil.
How about Benny Waters, was he in the band?
I don't remember. Benny told me he played with me. I thought he meant he played with my band.
Maybe he did play with your band.
He might have played with my band, but I don't remember it. He told me, down at the Overseas Club, don't you remember me, Snub, I played with you.
I don't remember.
Short, stocky guy, played clarinet and tenor sax.
Sure.
Rudy Powell; was Rudy in the band with you?
I met Rudy when I was with Fats.
But I think now Rudy was in that band, in Fletcher's band, because I guess Rudy was the one that told Fats about me.
Could be.
Allen Jack, Garvin Pushell (phonetic spelling)?
Pushell; right.
Gene Sedric?
I don't remember--Gene Sedric was with--
Chauncey Haughton maybe?
I don't remember Chaun-cey.
Allen Jackson?
I don't remember them, but that doesn't mean that--
No, it was a big band and when you were working with them--in other words, during the time that you were working with them, you were working with them for maybe two months?
It wasn't any more than that.
That would have been the maximum.
That was the maximum amount; if that long.
It could have been maybe just a month. If you were only playing college dates, it probably was just a short time.
That's all I played.
